name: XAI
rootCause: A Rug Pull occurred with the XAI token on the BNB Chain, where the deployer dumped 20,779 billion XAI tokens, making a profit of approximately $220,000.

descriptions.text: A Rug Pull occurred with the XAI token on the BNB Chain, where the deployer dumped 20,779 billion XAI tokens, making a profit of approximately $220,000.

A fake XAI token on BNB Chain collapsed on 2024-01-10 after the deployer sold a large token position into the market. Contemporary reporting attributed roughly $220,000 in proceeds to the deployer. Public evidence identifies the event as a rug pull tied to an unofficial token that shared the XAI name during heightened interest around the legitimate Xai gaming token. Public reporting attributes the incident to a deployer-controlled token dump on an unofficial XAI-branded token deployed on BNB Chain.
